content: By simply extending the constant number INLINEFORM0 to different variables accordingly, both F INLINEFORM1 @ INLINEFORM2 and F INLINEFORM3 @ INLINEFORM4 are capable of reflecting the nature of variable number of phrases for each document, and a model can achieve the maximum INLINEFORM5 score of INLINEFORM6 if and only if it predicts the exact same phrases as the ground truth. Another merit of F INLINEFORM7 @ INLINEFORM8 is that it is independent from model outputs, therefore we can use it to compare existing models.
